title: Kūpuna cited after unlicensed contractor work
summary: The aging office is helping an older adult cited for an unpermitted home addition built after she relied on an unlicensed contractor, and she lacks the email address needed for a building permit. An architectural firm said it has seen older adults taken advantage of and agreed to help her with the violation notices.

timeline.text: The architectural firm agreed to help her address the notices of violation.
An architectural firm said it has been seeing older adults taken advantage of and then facing violations for unpermitted structures.
She does not have an email address, which is needed to get a building permit.
The addition was built after she relied on an unlicensed contractor.
